note: Reviewed prerequisite statements for path and demo candidates. Each entry quotes the catalog description it came from; 'requires' uses canonical skill names. Courses not listed fall back to curated guidance or 'not verified'. Reviewed 2026-09-28 against data_version 997a4813-dd69c366.

entries.title: Machine Learning: Algorithms in the Real World Specialization
entries.evidence: You should have a basic understanding of linear algebra (vector notation) and statistics (probability distributions and mean/median/mode).
entries.note: The same paragraph also asks for 'at least beginner-level background in Python programming'.

entries.title: Structuring Machine Learning Projects
entries.evidence: This is also a standalone course for learners who have basic machine learning knowledge.

entries.title: Statistics and Data Analysis with Excel, Part 1
entries.evidence: Designed for students with no prior statistics knowledge, this course will provide a foundation for further study in data science, data analytics, or machine learning.

entries.title: Cloud Fundamentals
entries.evidence: No prerequisites are needed to enroll in this course.

entries.title: Cloud Computing Primer: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
entries.evidence: This course is designed for semi-technical and business learners, providing a solid foundation of cloud computing basics.

entries.title: Cloud Computing Primer: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
entries.evidence: This course is designed for semi-technical and business learners, providing a solid foundation of cloud computing basics.

entries.title: Connecting to Devices and Networks
